simple.meaning: מַשְׁמָן (mashmân) is a Hebrew word meaning “fat , i.e. (literally and abstractly) fatness ; but usually (figuratively and concretely) a rich dish, a fertile field, a robust man.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַשְׁמָן (H4924) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 27:28, with occurrences in Genesis, Nehemiah, Psalms, Isaiah, Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַשְׁמָן (H4924) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַשְׁמָן (H4924) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַשְׁמָן (mashmân) / H4924 is traced through Genesis 27:28, Genesis 27:39, Nehemiah 8:10, Psalms 78:31 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: fat , i.e. (literally and abstractly) fatness ; but usually (figuratively and concretely) a rich dish, a fertile field, a robust man
definitions.full: H4924. mashman [ שָׁמָן ] noun [masculine] fat, fertile, place ; — plural construct הָאָרֶץ מִשְׁמַנֵּי (Ges §§ 20a , 93ee) Gen 27:23 (poem in J; מִן partit), 27:39 (poem in E; מִן priv. according to Thes Ew Di Gunk and others; < partitive here as v b, ᵑ9 [ ᵐ5 ἀπό in both], AV RV Nö Ency. Bib 1184 , compare Dr). [ מִשְׁמָן ] noun [masculine] fatness ; — construct יֵרָוֶה בְּשָׁרוֺ וּמִשְׁטַן Isa 17:14 (figurative); plural concrete: stout, vigorous, ones , suffix מִשְׁמַנָּיו 10:16 (opposed to רָווֺן on form see Ges § 93pp ), מִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶם Psa 78:31 ; = fertile spots , construct מְדִינָה מִשְׁמַנֵּי Dan 11:24 . compare also 1Sam 15:9 , see מִשְׁנֶה 3 [ מַשְׁמָן ] noun [masculine] fat piece, tid bit ; — plural מַשְׁמַנִּים (Ges l.c .) Neh 8:10 (for eating; מַמְתַקִּים for drinking).
